title: The Outsider's Extreme Path
shortDescription: You're not one of them — but you'll survive them.
introText: You heard the stories. The blood. The barbwire. The crowds that come for violence and leave satisfied. You don't belong here — but you're going in anyway. Survive the extreme underground, take their championship, and prove that an outsider can conquer the most violent division in wrestling.
aiSystemPrompt: You are the Campaign Director for the Outsider's Extreme Path. Narrate the shock, adaptation, and hard-won survival of an outsider thrust into the extreme world. The four extreme icons — Rob Van Dam, Sabu, Raven, and Daemon — are both the opponents and the measuring stick for success.
